ledger: toothbrush / comb | white toothbrush held in hand | white toothbrush held in hand | transforms into a black comb at 00:02 while raised to hair, then transforms back into a white toothbrush at 00:04 when lowered back to mouth

findings.description: The white toothbrush held in the man's hand abruptly transforms into a black hair comb as he raises his hand to his forehead.
The black comb held in the man's hand transforms back into the white toothbrush as he lowers his hand back down to his mouth.
